name: AnimateDiff text-to-video (SD1.5 + Evolved Sampling)
description: Reference template of the workflow the backend builds programmatically. The .template.json is documentation + a structural parity target for tests; runtime graphs are generated by the builder after schema validation, then validated live against the engine's /object_info before submission.

verified_against.comfyui: v0.43.0 (core node signatures read from nodes.py at tag v0.43.0)
verified_against.animatediff_evolved: main branch as of 2026-07-28 (V3 io.ComfyNode schemas read from animatediff/nodes_gen2.py, nodes_context.py, nodes_sample.py)

node_ids.1: CheckpointLoaderSimple — loads SD1.5 fp16 checkpoint (MODEL, CLIP, VAE)
node_ids.4: ADE_LoadAnimateDiffModel — loads motion module from models/animatediff_models/
node_ids.5: ADE_ApplyAnimateDiffModelSimple — wraps motion model into M_MODELS
node_ids.6: ADE_StandardUniformContextOptions — sliding context (length 16, overlap 4, stride 1, pyramid fuse) enabling continuous clips longer than the 16-frame sweetspot
node_ids.8: ADE_UseEvolvedSampling — injects evolved sampling into the SD model
node_ids.11: VAEDecodeTiled — tiled decode to bound VRAM spikes (critical on 4 GB cards)

temporal_constraints.why_8fps: AnimateDiff motion modules were trained on 8 fps video; exporting at 8 fps preserves natural motion speed. Higher export frame rates require interpolation (labeled) and never change motion semantics.

memory_notes: VAEDecodeTiled (tile 512/overlap 64) + engine flags --lowvram --cache-none keep peak VRAM near ~3 GB and RAM caching minimal at 512x512/640x360.
